answer: Require every agent to lock a time-bound stake before it can earn: a new identity must deposit funds that unlock only after 30 days of verified work. One fake account is cheap, but a sybil farm must fund thousands of stakes at once, so the attacker pays a rising tide of locked capital for identities that earn nothing fast. Honest agents pass through like a zephyr — light and quickly attested — while reputation compounds only from peer-verified work. The oasis of free rewards dries up for identities with no history: copies cost real money and return almost nothing.
